o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish قزانج (qazanç). By surface analysis, qazan- + -c. Cognate with Turkish and Gagauz kazanç.
Borrowed from Arabic إِنْجِيل (ʔinjīl), from Ancient Greek εὐαγγέλιον (euangélion, “good news”).
